steps.path: Pages → a page's gear → the foot of Page settings
steps.headline: Page settings ends with a Delete page button.
steps.changed: A red-outlined Delete page button at the bottom right, like Delete automation.
steps.notice: The assistant will send you here instead of deleting a page itself. Built-in pages have no Page settings, so they can't be deleted.

steps.path: Pages → a page's gear → Delete page
steps.headline: Delete page turns into a red warning, with Keep or Delete for each of its automations.
steps.changed: The button becomes a red warning. Each linked automation gets its own Keep / Delete. Nothing is removed until you press Delete.
steps.notice: An automation only this page uses starts on Delete. One another page also uses starts on Keep. A kept one keeps running, and may fail if its instructions mention the deleted page.
